display_name: 10类 PAMF 分支筛选三票门槛源域对照
description: 10类三票分支筛选对比原四票；复用同划分同种子的本轮 E20，从第 21 轮独立续训。
authorization: 2026-11-12 用户要求并行发布不同参数实验，并减少不必要的额外流程。

code.commit: actual committed release identity in runtime.json

data.dataset: ManyRx ten-class, previously validated original roles

roles.L_s: 6533 original; deterministic per-class split 5228 train / 1305 dev

data.train_ratio: source L split 80/20 by class with seed 20261112
data.validation_ref: existing data roles; Phase2 capsule not applicable
data.leo_config_ref: source practical training simulator, fixed epoch 999 and batch index for development

permissions.query_use: no target access in this pilot
permissions.claim_scope: Source-domain pilot; historical target tests exposed; no performance claim on targets

checkpoint.initialization: matching development-only scratch E20 plus own E30/E50
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: own current source-development scratch E20, same seed, source roles and exact L split
checkpoint.selection_rule: fixed final E50; source L_dev clean and physical accuracy equally weighted

execution.gpu_policy: wait until matching source baseline finishes, then GPUs 0,1,3; one total worker per GPU
execution.stop_rule: Baseline failure stops queue; technical failure stops new dispatch; preserve outputs and other owners

expected_artifacts: held-out source L clean and simulated-physical result
fixed comparison to four-vote source baseline

dimensions: clean and fixed source simulated practical
metrics_plan.prediction_ref: source L_dev only; no target predictions

rows.method: Hybrid plus branch prototype, three-of-five certificate; prototype temperature 0.2
rows.seed_notes: Internal L split seed in data; support/evaluation seeds not applicable; simulated channel uses fixed epoch and step.
rows.scenario: source clean and source simulated low suburban, mid urban, low urban
rows.budget_ref: matched scratch E20 reused; own 10 + 20 epochs, 6660 new updates

notes: One source-only candidate; original four-vote .2 candidate is the matched baseline.
The controller waits for the already-running source baseline to complete before admitting any GPU job.
Target tests do not select or tune this candidate. Historical target data are previously exposed.
At least 0.25 percentage point improvement in the equal clean/physical source mean is required for a separate multi-seed stage.
